events.text: Need a ladder to change a ceiling bulb
I’ll ask two awake neighbors who may be able to help.

events.item: ladder to change a ceiling bulb

events.text: Do you have a ladder to lend for changing a ceiling bulb?
Hi! Do you have a ladder someone could borrow to change a ceiling bulb?
Got a long one in the garage — aluminium, about six foot. You need it?
Hey — I don't have a ladder, but I do have the kids' step stool that might reach a lower ceiling. Want me to bring it down?
I’ll relay both offers and flag the safety concerns.

Sulaiman offers a roughly six-foot aluminium ladder; Alwalid offers a kids’ step stool that might reach a lower ceiling. I’d choose the ladder for reach, but switch off the power first and keep metal away from live electricity; which would you like?
I’ll arrange the ladder handover and release the stool offer.
Can Osama collect the ladder at your 2A door in 5 minutes?
Thanks for offering the stool! It won’t be needed after all.
Yeah. Tell Osama to come now — I'll leave it by 2A door.
No problem — glad it worked out! The kids already claimed the stool for a fort, anyway.
Confirming the agreed handover to Osama.
Sulaiman will leave the ladder by his 2A door; please collect it now. Switch off the power before changing the bulb.
